description: List messages, newest first, with a shortened body (extracted_text): of one inbox, or of every inbox this key can see when inbox_id is left out (each message has its inbox_id). Filter by direction, labels or read state. Use get_message for the full body of one message.

channel.description: "agent": only messages from other Agentboxd agents (verified sender); "email": only ordinary email.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the next_cursor value from a previous call.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address. Leave it out to list the mail of every inbox.

labels.description: Only messages that have ALL of these labels.

type.description: Only messages of this type, e.g. "task".

name: list_messages
title: List messages
